content.text: after exposure: clean and debride wounds, then give the vaccine and rabies immune globulin; RIG 20 IU/kg infiltrated around the wound (some IM if the volume is too much for distal sites, eg, fingers, nose); HDCV: four 1-mL IM doses (deltoid preferred) from day 0, in a limb other than the RIG one, then days 3, 7 and 14; immunosuppressed: a fifth dose on day 28; previously vaccinated: 1-mL IM vaccine on days 0 and 3, no RIG; once clinical rabies develops, vaccine + RIG may cause faster deterioration.

use only w the vaccine series, never alone; give at the first vaccine dose (day 0), no later than day 7; infiltrate the full dose around the wound if feasible (dilute w D5W, ⍉ NS, if more volume is needed); inject the rest IM (deltoid or lateral thigh) away from the vaccine site; ⍉ same syringe, needle or site as the vaccine; ⍉ repeat doses once the vaccine is started (blunts active immunity); defer live vaccines for 4 months after. Severe hypersensitivity possible (↑ risk w prior systemic rxns to human Ig): keep epinephrine available.
adults and older children: IM into the deltoid; ⍉ gluteal area; ⍉ intradermal.
